text: Not all men, but if I gave you a box of Whoppers and I told you that one out of every ten of them was actually a piece of human sh** rolled into a ball and dipped in chocolate, you'd be wary of all of them, would you not? That's what I thought. Okay, let's go with your example. Just in case you thought we were done with the whole Whopper analogy for sexual violence, we most certainly are not. Because there are some people who insist on not understanding, or there are fellas like the one that I'm stitching right here, who in fact does understand it, walks straight into the point, and somehow misses it entirely anyway. Guys, for a second I thought Nick went crazy and made another reaction to my video. But no, this is another guy, Professor Neo. Professor, sorry, you are just a little too late to this point. I just finished debating that Nick Powers guy on this topic. If only it'd shown up a couple of days earlier. But Nick actually made points quite similar to yours. You guys even used similar phrases, like walked into the point and missed it. You sure you are not some type of brothers who got separated as kids? If not, you guys should become friends. Anyways, you can watch my debates with Nick to get some answers. They wouldn't be specifically tailored to your video, but they go in a very similar direction. You did top Nick in one thing, though. He called me different things. But even he didn't call me a sh**ball. I thought professors were supposed to be decent and have manners. Apparently not. Anyways, we still can't leave a whole professor without an answer. Luckily, our professor has another video, which I'm going to check. It's 1 in 20, 1 in 50, 1 in 100. And it's true. The 1 in 10 is wrong. Actually, more like 1 in 7 men who have attempted or completed the rape of a woman. More than 1 in 3 who have sexually assaulted a woman, period. It's 5 in 10 of us who have badgered a woman who said no until she changed her answer. 8 in 10 of us who have lied to a woman in order to convince her to sleep with us. And more than 9 in 10 of us who have admitted to not accepting no as an answer. So yes, it is not 1 in 10 whoppers that is secretly bullsh**. It is so much worse than that. I think I'm getting deja vu over here. It's almost like there was recently another influencer who made sensational claims about the general male population and got crushed for it. But anyways, here are professors' claims. Claim number 1. 1 in 7 men have attempted or completed the rape of a woman. Claim number 2. More than 1 in 3 have sexually assaulted a woman. Claims number 3, 4 and 5. 5 in 10 badgered until she changed her answer. 8 in 10 lied to convince her. And more than 9 in 10 didn't accept no. Well, professor, buckle up. We will start our lecture soon.
